functions.name: aggiorna_stato_richiesta_dopo_fattibilita
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.aggiorna_stato_richiesta_dopo_fattibilita()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    -- Aggiorna lo stato della richiesta da 'nuova' a 'in corso'
    UPDATE rdf_richieste 
    SET stato = 'in corso'
    WHERE id = NEW.richiesta_id 
    AND stato = 'nuova';
    
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

views.name: v_employee_certifications
views.definition:
SELECT ca.id AS award_id,
    e.id AS employee_id,
    e.last_name,
    e.first_name,
    c.code AS cert_code,
    c.name AS cert_name,
    ca.outcome,
    ca.awarded_on,
    ca.expires_on,
        CASE
            WHEN (ca.expires_on IS NULL) THEN 'valid_no_expiry'::text
            WHEN (ca.expires_on > CURRENT_DATE) THEN 'valid'::text
            ELSE 'expired'::text
        END AS current_status,
    ca.validation_source
   FROM ((training.certification_award ca
     JOIN training.employee e ON ((e.id = ca.employee_id)))
     JOIN training.certification c ON ((c.id = ca.certification_id)));

views.name: v_expiring_certifications
views.definition:
SELECT e.id AS employee_id,
    e.last_name,
    e.first_name,
    e.email,
    c.code AS cert_code,
    c.name AS cert_name,
    ca.expires_on,
    (ca.expires_on - CURRENT_DATE) AS days_to_expiry
   FROM ((training.certification_award ca
     JOIN training.employee e ON ((e.id = ca.employee_id)))
     JOIN training.certification c ON ((c.id = ca.certification_id)))
  WHERE ((ca.outcome = 'passed_exam'::training.award_outcome) AND (ca.expires_on IS NOT NULL) AND (ca.expires_on > CURRENT_DATE) AND (e.status = 'active'::training.employee_status));

views.name: v_mandatory_compliance_gap
views.definition:
WITH required AS (
         SELECT population.rule_id,
            employee.id AS employee_id,
            employee.last_name,
            employee.first_name,
            course.id AS course_id,
            course.title AS course_title,
            course.leads_to_cert_id,
            course.compliance_framework,
            course.recurrence_interval
           FROM (((training.v_mandatory_rule_population population
             JOIN training.mandatory_rules rule ON ((rule.id = population.rule_id)))
             JOIN training.course course ON (((course.id = rule.course_id) AND course.is_active)))
             JOIN training.employee employee ON ((employee.id = population.employee_id)))
        ), coverage AS (
         SELECT req.rule_id,
            req.employee_id,
            req.last_name,
            req.first_name,
            req.course_id,
            req.course_title,
            req.leads_to_cert_id,
            req.compliance_framework,
            req.recurrence_interval,
            ( SELECT max(award.awarded_on) AS max
                   FROM training.certification_award award
                  WHERE ((req.leads_to_cert_id IS NOT NULL) AND (award.employee_id = req.employee_id) AND (award.certification_id = req.leads_to_cert_id) AND (award.outcome = 'passed_exam'::training.award_outcome) AND ((award.expires_on IS NULL) OR (award.expires_on > CURRENT_DATE)) AND ((req.recurrence_interval IS NULL) OR ((award.awarded_on + req.recurrence_interval) > CURRENT_DATE)))) AS last_valid_awarded_on,
            ( SELECT max(COALESCE(enrollment.actual_end, enrollment.planned_end)) AS max
                   FROM training.enrollment enrollment
                  WHERE ((req.leads_to_cert_id IS NULL) AND (enrollment.employee_id = req.employee_id) AND (enrollment.course_id = req.course_id) AND (enrollment.status = 'completed'::training.enrollment_status) AND (COALESCE(enrollment.actual_end, enrollment.planned_end) IS NOT NULL) AND ((req.recurrence_interval IS NULL) OR ((COALESCE(enrollment.actual_end, enrollment.planned_end) + req.recurrence_interval) > CURRENT_DATE)))) AS last_valid_completed_on
           FROM required req
        )
 SELECT rule_id,
    employee_id,
    last_name,
    first_name,
    course_id,
    course_title,
    compliance_framework,
    last_valid_awarded_on,
    last_valid_completed_on,
        CASE
            WHEN ((leads_to_cert_id IS NOT NULL) AND (last_valid_awarded_on IS NOT NULL)) THEN 'compliant'::text
            WHEN ((leads_to_cert_id IS NULL) AND (last_valid_completed_on IS NOT NULL)) THEN 'compliant'::text
            ELSE 'missing_or_expired'::text
        END AS compliance_status
   FROM coverage;

views.name: v_mandatory_rule_population
views.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT rule.id AS rule_id,
    employee.id AS employee_id
   FROM (training.mandatory_rules rule
     JOIN training.employee employee ON ((employee.status = 'active'::training.employee_status)))
  WHERE (rule.is_active AND (((rule.population_target ->> 'kind'::text) = 'all'::text) OR (((rule.population_target ->> 'kind'::text) = 'team'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM training.team_membership tm
          WHERE ((tm.employee_id = employee.id) AND (tm.team_id = ((rule.population_target ->> 'id'::text))::uuid) AND (tm.start_date <= now()) AND ((tm.end_date IS NULL) OR (tm.end_date >= now())))))) OR (((rule.population_target ->> 'kind'::text) = 'skill_area'::text) AND ((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM training.skill_assessment assessment
          WHERE ((assessment.employee_id = employee.id) AND (assessment.skill_area_id = ((rule.population_target ->> 'id'::text))::uuid)))) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM (training.enrollment enrollment
             JOIN training.course course ON ((course.id = enrollment.course_id)))
          WHERE ((enrollment.employee_id = employee.id) AND (course.skill_area_id = ((rule.population_target ->> 'id'::text))::uuid)))) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM (training.certification_award award
             JOIN training.certification certification ON ((certification.id = award.certification_id)))
          WHERE ((award.employee_id = employee.id) AND (certification.skill_area_id = ((rule.population_target ->> 'id'::text))::uuid)))))) OR (((rule.population_target ->> 'kind'::text) = 'custom_group'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM training.custom_group_members member
          WHERE ((member.group_id = ((rule.population_target ->> 'id'::text))::uuid) AND (member.employee_id = employee.id)))))));

views.name: v_plan_budget
views.definition:
SELECT tp.year,
    t.code AS team_code,
    count(*) AS enrollments_count,
    sum(COALESCE(en.cost_actual, en.cost_planned, c.default_cost)) AS cost_total,
    sum(COALESCE(en.hours_actual, en.hours_planned, c.default_hours)) AS hours_total
   FROM ((((training.enrollment en
     JOIN training.training_plan tp ON ((tp.id = en.training_plan_id)))
     JOIN training.course c ON ((c.id = en.course_id)))
     LEFT JOIN training.team_membership tm ON (((tm.employee_id = en.employee_id) AND (tm.start_date <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND ((tm.end_date IS NULL) OR (tm.end_date >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)))))
     LEFT JOIN training.team t ON ((t.id = tm.team_id)))
  GROUP BY tp.year, t.code;
